title: Wealth Flow Systems
hook: Best income year ever. Somehow nothing to show for it.
statement: Wealth is what you keep, held over time.
explainer: Big income with big expenses builds nothing. Net flow, sustained, builds everything.
sop: Track real Income and Expense one month.
Plug one leak. Invest the difference.
equation_example: Income $8,000 minus Expense $5,000 = $3,000. Times 12 months = $36,000 Wealth.
question: Write your real monthly income minus expenses. Just the number.
closing_statement: Income you don't keep isn't wealth.
